_comment: Official Jamaica government budget sources. URLs verified live on mof.gov.jm. Hub pages link to the actual PDFs (Estimates, Fiscal Policy Paper, Public Bodies). Set 'is_pdf': true and a direct .pdf 'url' once you copy the specific document link from the hub page, then the app can fetch & extract it on demand.

sources.title: Budget Presentation / Speech
sources.description: Annual budget presentation hub (Ministry of Finance & the Public Service).

sources.title: Estimates of Expenditure (Annual & Supplementary)
sources.description: Estimates of Expenditure by ministry, programme and object. Primary source for central-government recurrent and capital lines.

sources.description: Public Bodies' capital and operating estimates. Keep public-body capex SEPARATE from central government unless explicitly consolidated.

sources.description: Fiscal Policy Papers (macro-fiscal framework, fiscal targets).

sources.description: Plain-language summary of the budget for the public.
